key_claims.claim: Exome or genome sequencing after non-diagnostic CMA identifies a pathogenic or likely pathogenic variant in 30% of fetuses with prenatal ACC, rising to 41% when extracranial anomalies are present
A 10-year two-center cohort characterizes prenatal ultrasound findings in closed spinal dysraphism and links them to functional outcomes at 18 and 36 months
After euploid embryo transfer, residual confirmed aneuploidy risk is 0.1% and cfDNA sensitivity for detecting these cases is only 50%
A genetic cause is identified in approximately 30% of fully investigated fetal intracranial hemorrhage cases
A multivariable model combining sagittal aortic-arch parameters outperforms any single parameter for prenatal coarctation detection
